Cookies Policy

Skootlink (Pty) Ltd
Last Updated: 16 June 2026

1. INTRODUCTION

1.1 Skootlink (Pty) Ltd ("Skootlink", "we", "us", or "our") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website and mobile application (collectively, the "Platform"). This Cookies Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and the choices you have regarding their use.

1.2 This policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. Any terms not defined in this policy have the meanings given to them in the Privacy Policy.

1.3 By continuing to browse or use our Platform after accepting our cookie notice, you consent to the use of cookies and similar technologies as described in this policy. You may withdraw your consent at any time by adjusting your cookie settings or browser preferences.

2. WHAT ARE COOKIES?

2.1 Cookies are small text files that a website or application places on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit. Cookies are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, improve user experience, and provide information to the site owners.

2.2 Cookies may be "first-party" (set by our Platform) or "third-party" (set by a domain other than ours, such as an analytics or payment service provider). They may be "session cookies" (deleted when you close your browser) or "persistent cookies" (remaining on your device for a set period or until manually deleted).

2.3 Similar technologies, such as web beacons (also known as pixel tags or clear GIFs), local storage, and software development kits (SDKs) on mobile applications, may also be used for the same purposes described below. In this policy, we use the term "cookies" to refer to all such technologies.

3. HOW WE USE COOKIES

3.1 We use cookies for the following purposes:

  • (a) To enable and maintain your authenticated session on the Platform.
  • (b) To remember your preferences and settings, such as your chosen language or account type.
  • (c) To understand how you interact with the Platform, in order to improve its functionality and user experience.
  • (d) To detect and prevent fraudulent or malicious activity.
  • (e) To analyse usage trends and measure the effectiveness of our communications.
  • (f) Where you have expressly consented, to deliver relevant promotional content or measure the performance of advertising campaigns.

3.2 We do not use cookies to collect personal information without your knowledge, and we do not sell or rent cookie data to third parties.

4. TYPES OF COOKIES WE USE

We categorise the cookies we use as follows:

4.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies
These cookies are essential for the Platform to operate correctly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. You cannot disable these cookies, as the Platform will not function properly without them.

Cookie / Technology Purpose Duration Provider
Session cookies (e.g., sb-access-token, sb-refresh-token) Maintain your login session and ensure secure access to your account. Duration of session or until token expires First-party (Skootlink / Supabase Auth)
CSRF tokens Protect against cross-site request forgery attacks on forms. Session First-party
Load balancing cookies Optimise server performance and response times. Session First-party / hosting provider

4.2 Performance and Analytics Cookies
These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the Platform by collecting and reporting information anonymously. They allow us to count visits, identify traffic sources, and measure page response times. All information collected by these cookies is aggregated and cannot be used to identify you individually.

Cookie / Technology Purpose Duration Provider
Analytics cookies (e.g., _ga, _gid if using Google Analytics, or Supabase/Netlify analytics) Distinguish unique users, track page views, and generate statistical data on Platform usage. Up to 2 years Third-party (e.g., Google LLC, Netlify)
Performance monitoring cookies Monitor application performance and detect errors. Session Various (e.g., Sentry, LogRocket, if used)

4.3 Functional Cookies
Functional cookies allow the Platform to remember choices you make and provide enhanced, more personalised features. They may be set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our Platform.

Cookie / Technology Purpose Duration Provider
Preference cookies (e.g., lang, theme) Remember your chosen language, display theme, or other customisations. Up to 1 year First-party
Third-party integration cookies (e.g., from Payfast, Google Maps) Enable interactive services such as payment processing, map displays, and route planning. Varies (typically session to 1 year) Payfast, Google Maps, Mapbox, etc.

4.4 Targeting and Advertising Cookies (if applicable)
We do not currently use targeting or advertising cookies that track your browsing across other websites for the purpose of displaying interest-based advertisements. If this changes in the future, we will update this policy and obtain your prior consent before deploying such cookies.

5. THIRD-PARTY COOKIES

5.1 Some cookies are placed by third-party service providers who assist us in operating the Platform, processing payments, analysing usage, or delivering communications. These third parties may process data about your visit to our Platform, and their use of cookies is governed by their own privacy and cookie policies. We encourage you to review the relevant policies:

  • Payfast (payment processing): https://www.payfast.co.za/privacy-policy/
  • Brevo (Sendinblue) (email communications): https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/
  • Google Maps / Mapbox (maps and location services, if implemented): https://policies.google.com/privacy / https://www.mapbox.com/legal/privacy
  • Supabase (backend and authentication): https://supabase.com/privacy
  • Netlify (hosting and analytics): https://www.netlify.com/privacy/

5.2 We do not control these third-party cookies and are not responsible for their privacy practices. Please check the applicable third-party policies for more information.

6. COOKIES ON OUR MOBILE APPLICATION

6.1 Our mobile application may use tracking technologies equivalent to cookies, such as local storage, device identifiers, and SDKs provided by third-party services (e.g., Supabase, Payfast, mapping SDKs, and analytics SDKs). These technologies serve the same purposes as cookies on the website.

6.2 On mobile devices, you can manage or reset your advertising identifier and location permissions through your device settings (iOS: Settings > Privacy & Security; Android: Settings > Google > Ads, or Settings > Privacy).

7. YOUR CHOICES AND HOW TO MANAGE COOKIES

7.1 Cookie Consent Banner: When you first visit our Platform, you will be presented with a cookie consent banner. You may accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or customise your preferences. Strictly necessary cookies cannot be disabled as they are required for the Platform to function. Your consent will be stored for a period of up to twelve (12) months, after which you may be asked to reconfirm your preferences.

7.2 Browser Settings: You can manage or delete cookies at any time through your web browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

  • See what cookies are stored on your device and delete them individually.
  • Block third-party cookies.
  • Block all cookies from specific sites.
  • Block all cookies from being set.
  • Delete all cookies when you close your browser.

Blocking all cookies may impact your ability to use certain features of the Platform, particularly those requiring authentication.

For instructions on how to adjust your settings, consult your browser's help pages:

  • Google Chrome: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95647
  • Mozilla Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/cookies-information-websites-store-on-your-computer
  • Apple Safari: https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/manage-cookies-and-website-data-sfri11471/mac
  • Microsoft Edge: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/manage-cookies-in-microsoft-edge

7.3 Opt-Out Tools: Some third-party analytics and advertising providers offer opt-out mechanisms. For example, you can opt out of Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on, available at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

8. DATA RETENTION

8.1 The retention periods for data collected via cookies are set out in the tables above. In general, data collected by session cookies is deleted when you close your browser, while data from persistent cookies is retained for the specified period or until you delete the cookie. We retain aggregated, anonymised analytical data indefinitely.

9. UPDATES TO THIS COOKIES POLICY

9.1 We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our use of cookies, the services we deploy, or applicable legal requirements. When we make material changes, we will notify you by posting a notice on the Platform and, where appropriate, by email. The "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy indicates when it was last revised.

9.2 Your continued use of the Platform after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
